description: A methodology for services that deploy cleanly anywhere: config in the environment, stateless processes, logs to stdout, build once and promote.
Everything that differs between deploys (URLs, keys, flags) comes from environment variables, not from code or committed files.
Parse and validate `process.env` once at startup (for example with Zod) and crash with a clear message when something is missing or malformed.
Encrypted storage for credentials (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Doppler) that injects them into the environment at runtime.
Build an immutable artifact once, combine it with an environment's config to release, then run it unchanged.
A committed file listing every variable with safe placeholders; the real `.env` stays out of Git.
